newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln Wednesday Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln Wednesday Nov 20.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.31 billion in 50 offerings for Wednesday Nov 20, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $552 million in 31 offerings. The largest is a two-part $205 Lower Colorado River Authority, Texas, offering at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $767 million in 19 offerings. The largest issue is a $200 million New York Triborough Bridge and Tunnel Authority offering through PaineWebber Inc.
There are 6 issues totaling $129 million on the day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them on Wednesday depending on market conditions.
